svg.title: Commercial LV cabling design - installation view
svg.desc: Cutaway isometric view of the 400 V three-tenancy supply as it is built: a green padmount kiosk holding the 500 kVA transformer at the site boundary, fifteen metres of buried consumer mains in five conduits with sand bedding and a marker tape rising into the building, and a switchroom holding the floor-standing main switchboard with a metre of clear space in front. Each tenancy has its own distribution board inside its own bay, fed from the switchboard along a cable tray. The prospective fault current at the main switchboard is 8.0 kA against a 10 kA device rating.
